# DampScan

> Independent damp, mould and timber survey specialists covering London, Kent,
> Surrey, Essex, East and West Sussex, Hertfordshire, Berkshire and
> Buckinghamshire. DampScan diagnoses the cause of a damp problem before any
> treatment is recommended, then carries out the remedial work if the customer
> wants it.

DampScan surveys for homeowners, buyers, landlords and managing agents. The
core principle is diagnosis before treatment: most repeat damp problems are
second visits to work that treated a symptom rather than a cause.

## What happens

- Enquiries get a response the same day.
- The written report follows within 24 hours of the survey visit.
- Every survey includes calibrated moisture readings, an inspection inside and
  out, photographed evidence, the diagnosed cause and a fixed-price quote.
- There is no obligation to book work after a survey, and no follow-up chasing.
- Remedial work carries an insured workmanship guarantee. The term depends on
  the treatment and is stated on the quote before anything is agreed.

## Problems covered

Rising damp, penetrating damp, condensation and mould, timber decay, woodworm,
wet rot and dry rot, basement and cellar waterproofing, ventilation design,
rendering and plastering, and independent damp surveys including pre-purchase
surveys and second opinions on invasive damp-proofing quotes.

## Second opinions

DampScan is regularly asked to review a quote for invasive damp-proofing from
another firm and will say plainly when that work is not justified.

## Areas

London, Kent, Surrey, Essex, East Sussex, West Sussex, Hertfordshire,
Berkshire and Buckinghamshire.

## Related practice

ATI Damp Survey (atidampsurvey.co.uk) is the London survey-only practice. It
carries out no remedial work at all, which suits buyers, solicitors and
disrepair cases where the report needs to have nothing to sell.
